text:
sara_partnerships: Quick vendor sync. Vendors reported staggered firmware/microcode timelines that could affect H100/H200/MI300 slotting and whether we wave the marketplace announce. Need a pragmatic plan for embargoes and fallback routing.
marco_ops: Which vendors and what magnitude? numbers pls.
pablo_amd: AMD partner-preview microcode shows MI300 long-seq uplift ~+6-9% vs baseline after microcode. Partner-preview image will land Mon 14:00 PT.
jen_nvidia: Nvidia stability team: some H200 configs show sustained-power derate ~10-12% at full racks. Microcode/kernel patch in validation, ETA mid-week.
zara_habana: Gaudi note: driver 2.7 available, low-risk kv-cache tweak. No capacity change expected.
lisa_product: Product preference: avoid full-stop on announce unless >10% derate on GA SKUs. We can publish "initial availability" with provisional perf profiles and update post-fix.
aj_legal: Legal: if we publish and later materially change perf claims (>5% delta), we need a pre-approved correction template and 48h buffer before public press. No retracts without counsel sign-off.
marco_ops: Ops: propose tagging SKUs with flags and gating by region. Example flags: ```["available","provisional_perf","pending_vendor_image"]``` and gating CSV: region,sku,flag,expected_fix_date.
sara_partnerships: Partnerships will draft partner note and embargo guidance. Marketing wants a 72h safe window if numbers change; Legal wants 48h. Can we compromise 72h?
aj_legal: 72h preferred for press. For partner notes, 48h is acceptable if the vendor provides measured deltas and test configs.
marco_ops: Deploy-bot, can you schedule staging perf sweeps for MI300/H200/Gaudi images as vendors push preview images?
deploy-bot: scheduled perf-sweep jobs: #6123 (us-east-1), #6124 (eu-west-1). Images: amd/mi300:preview, nvidia/h200:candidate, habana/gaudi:2.7. ETA results: 5-7 hours. Will post CSV link on completion. :white_check_mark:
pablo_amd: We'll upload partner-preview image to s3://partners/mi300/preview and ping here when available.
jen_nvidia: Sharing compat matrix doc shortly. Note: H200 fix requires kernel 5.19+ in some configs.
lisa_product: Marketplace UX: add small banner text on SKUs: "Performance profiles provisional; final numbers subject to vendor firmware updates." Draft banner ok?
aj_legal: Banner text approved. But include a link to a partner-facing note with measured deltas and test configs.
sara_partnerships: Proposed go/no-go rules: - If derate <=5%: proceed with announce + provisional profiles. - If derate 5-10%: proceed but mark as provisional and delay press 72h. - If derate >10%: hold public press, do partner notes only and enable fallback routing.
marco_ops: Fallback routing rules (draft): prefer MI300 for long-context (>8k) if H200 derates >10%; if MI300 capacity limited, route to B200 pools with a throttle. I'll codify as routing-policy v1.
jen_nvidia: We'll try to accelerate validation. If patched images land earlier we can shorten partner-delay.
sara_partnerships: Actions: 1) Partnerships draft partner note + embargo guidance (sara). 2) Ops run sweeps and produce gating CSV (marco). 3) Product add banner + sku_flags (lisa). 4) Legal/Marketing finalize press buffer & correction templates (aj_legal). 5) Vendors to upload preview images and compat matrices (pablo_amd, jen_nvidia, zara_habana). Reconvene in this thread after perf CSVs posted. :calendar:
marco_ops: Noted, starting CSV template now. Will post link to docs when ready.
sara_partnerships: Thanks all. If vendors confirm fixes >72h out and derate >10%, we'll shift to a staggered wave plan and notify sales for reserved-slot customers. :rocket:
